site_match_rider.basis: Site Match simulation: honest uplift N(0.8, 0.5) C, files on 50% of eligible days, 10 h cap; expected top-up 7.16 h a worker a year

reinsurance.note: Attachment 150%, decided and confirmed by the team on 2026-11-15. The cheaper alternative inside the 5% budget would be 100%; 150% was kept as catastrophe protection that costs almost nothing while the back-test never reaches it.

market.basis: 185,400 in-scope workers = 75% construction x 60% SME x 70% outdoor of MOM work permit holders + 10,800 landscape + 20,000 outdoor cleaners (assumptions). Income share 12% (assumption). Year 3 = 40% attach on Income book + 6,000 via associations.

haze_load_h.basis: About 5 haze episodes in 30 years (1997, 2006, 2013, 2015, 2019), roughly 5 to 20 insured haze hours each. Added because NEA PSI before 2025 is not in the back-test.

working_days_per_year.basis: Mon to Sat (312 days) minus about 10 public holidays on working days.

fixed_cost_sgd.basis: Income's fixed cost to add and run a section on an existing WIC policy (question for Income's mentor).

variable_expense_ratio.basis: Commission, payments and servicing, from the CONTEXT.md premium split.

policy_workers.basis: Workers per policy for break-even and the firm sheet (the 20-worker example firm).

reinsurer_load.basis: Reinsurer price as a multiple of expected recovery for an aggregate stop-loss.

reinsurance_budget.basis: Share of premium set aside for reinsurance and capital in the split.

idle_hour_cost_sgd.basis: Declared salary plus levy spread over working hours for a work permit holder.

monthly_labour_cost_sgd.basis: Salary, levy and housing a work permit holder a month; sets premium as a share of the labour bill.

site_match_rider_week.basis: Rider price until real site logs are tested (replaced by the Site Match simulation in P8).
